senses.gloss: f. (חָבַר) company, association, party; esp. those united for eating the Passover lamb in company (Ex. XII, 4); the colleagues at school (v. חָבֵר); the college.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 7:3">Pes. VII, 3</cite>, a. fr. <he>בני ח׳</he> the members of a Passover party.

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 7:3">Ib.</cite> <he>אם חֲבוּרַת כהנים</he> if it is a party consisting of priests only. Y. ib. X, 37ᵈ top <he>שלא יהא עומד מח׳ זו וכ׳</he> that one should not rise from one party and join another; Bab. ib. 119ᵇ, v. <cite ref="A02709"><he>אֶפִּיקוֹמָן</he></cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 9b:18">Ber. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>במעמד כל הח׳</he> in the presence of the whole college.
<cite ref="Nedarim 81a:2">Ned. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>הזהרו בח׳</he> beware of disregarding the benefits of collegiate studies.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 2">Lev. R. s. 2</cite>, end <he>חֲבוּרָתוֹ של משה</he> the disciples of Moses; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:3:7">Y. Dem. II, 23ᵃ</cite> top <he>דוחין אותו מחבורתו</he>, v. <cite ref="H00121"><he>חֲבֵירוּת</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>חֲנוּרוֹת</he>.
